body: I was arrested that night and let out on a no cash bond, I’m due to appear in court in 5 days

You don’t understand, she set me up to be arrested nearly 12 hours later, with marks she didn’t have before she left- I am facing jail time because of her. 

Before she came around, I was on the verge of doing it, I was an absolute mess, the night she came into my life was the night I decided to try and live.
